{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017WedwjPTmKWVbkRnCS7XSB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing System.Net;\n2\tusing System.Text;\n3\tusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\n4\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n5\tusing Guardrails.Core.State;\n6\tusing JournalTaskStatus = Guardrails.Core.Journal.TaskStatus;\n7\t\n8\tnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n9\t\n10\t/// <summary>\n11\t/// The SINGLE renderer for the log viewer's HTML — the LIVE <see cref=\"LogServer\"/> (dynamic pages\n12\t/// polled client-side), the DURING-RUN static site (rewritten on the fly as tasks settle, issue\n13\t/// #141 item 2), and the DURABLE post-hoc export (<c>guardrails logs --export</c>, SSOT §12.3) all\n14\t/// consume it, so there is no forked look-alike (#103 Request 2). They share the page SHELL (CSS +\n15\t/// layout + the same status colours); they differ ONLY in the index's per-task link target and\n16\t/// whether the index auto-refreshes:\n17\t/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n18\t///   <item>DURING-RUN index — a <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"&gt;</c> so a <c>file://</c> view\n19\t///     re-reads it as the harness rewrites it; a RUNNING task links to the LIVE server URL (a click\n20\t///     tails it), a settled/with-attempts task links to its static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>,\n21\t///     a pending/no-attempts task is plain text.</item>\n22\t///   <item>FINAL / <c>--export</c> index — NO refresh, ALL links static (durable, non-flickering).</item>\n23\t/// </list>\n24\t///\n25\t/// <para>The static site is written next to the artifacts it renders, under the <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c>\n26\t/// audit tree (NEVER <c>state/</c>, which is mutable run state): one <c>index.html</c> per task plus a\n27\t/// site <c>index.html</c>. It is non-authored audit (excluded from <c>guardrails.baseline</c>, like\n28\t/// <c>diagram.html</c>) and is cleared with the rest of <c>logs/</c> by <c>--fresh</c>.</para>\n29\t/// </summary>\n30\tpublic static class LogSiteRenderer\n31\t{\n32\t    // The shared page CSS (dark theme + the status-word colours). The live LogServer templates and the\n33\t    // static export both embed THIS constant, so a visual change lands in one place — the renderer-drift\n34\t    // trap the project already solved for diagram.md / diagram.html.\n35\t    public const string SharedStyle = \"\"\"\n36\t  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 1.5rem; background: #0b0f14; color: #d6deeb; }\n37\t  h1 { font-size: 1.2rem; }\n38\t  h2 { font-size: 1rem; color: #8aa0b3; margin-top: 1.6rem; }\n39\t  p { color: #8aa0b3; }\n40\t  a { color: #7fdbff; text-decoration: none; }\n41\t  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n42\t  .bar { color: #8aa0b3; margin-bottom: .8rem; }\n43\t  table { border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 1rem; width: 100%; }\n44\t  td, th { padding: .45rem .8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c2733; text-align: left; }\n45\t  th { color: #8aa0b3; font-weight: 600; }\n46\t  select { background: #121a24; color: #d6deeb; border: 1px solid #243343; border-radius: 4px; padding: .2rem .4rem; }\n47\t  td.status, span.status { font-weight: 600; }\n48\t  .status[data-status=\"succeeded\"], .status[data-status=\"skipped\"] { color: #3fb950; }\n49\t  .status[data-status=\"needs-human\"], .status[data-status=\"failed\"] { color: #f85149; }\n50\t  .status[data-status=\"running\"] { color: #d29922; }\n51\t  .status[data-status=\"pending\"], .status[data-status=\"blocked\"], .status[data-status=\"unknown\"] { color: #8aa0b3; }\n52\t  .empty, option.empty { color: #6b7a8d; }\n53\t  pre { background: #06090d; border: 1px solid #1c2733; border-radius: 6px; padding: 1rem;\n54\t        white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.35;\n55\t        max-height: 70vh; overflow: auto; }\n56\t\"\"\";\n57\t\n58\t    // Per-attempt file the static page inlines FIRST (mirrors LogServer's PreferenceOrder): the groomed\n59\t    // transcript leads, then the raw stream, then script stdout.\n60\t    private static readonly string[] PreferenceOrder =\n61\t        [\"transcript.md\", \"claude-stream.jsonl\", \"action-stdout.log\"];\n62\t\n63\t    private static readonly Encoding Utf8NoBom = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false);\n64\t\n65\t    /// <summary>\n66\t    /// The per-task link target an index renders for one task. <see cref=\"StaticPage\"/> points at the\n67\t    /// task's static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>; <see cref=\"Live\"/> carries an absolute live-server\n68\t    /// URL whose click tails the task; <see cref=\"PlainText\"/> renders the id as plain text (no anchor).\n69\t    /// </summary>\n70\t    public enum LinkKind\n71\t    {\n72\t        /// <summary>Plain text — no anchor (a pending / no-attempts task offline).</summary>\n73\t        PlainText,\n74\t\n75\t        /// <summary>A relative link to the task's static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>.</summary>\n76\t        StaticPage,\n77\t\n78\t        /// <summary>An absolute live-server URL (a click tails the running task).</summary>\n79\t        Live,\n80\t    }\n81\t\n82\t    /// <summary>How an index renders one task: the link target kind plus the URL for a <see cref=\"LinkKind.Live\"/> link.</summary>\n83\t    public readonly record struct IndexLink(LinkKind Kind, string? LiveUrl = null)\n84\t    {\n85\t        /// <summary>A plain-text (non-link) cell.</summary>\n86\t        public static readonly IndexLink Plain = new(LinkKind.PlainText);\n87\t\n88\t        /// <summary>A relative link to the task's static page.</summary>\n89\t        public static readonly IndexLink Static = new(LinkKind.StaticPage);\n90\t\n91\t        /// <summary>An absolute live-server link to tail the running task.</summary>\n92\t        public static IndexLink LiveTo(string url) => new(LinkKind.Live, url);\n93\t    }\n94\t\n95\t    /// <summary>\n96\t    /// Export the whole DURABLE static site for one run into <paramref name=\"logsRoot\"/>\n97\t    /// (<c>&lt;planDir&gt;/logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c>): a per-task <c>index.html</c> for every task that\n98\t    /// has attempts on disk, plus a site <c>index.html</c> with NO refresh and ALL-static links. Idempotent\n99\t    /// — regenerates everything each call (like <c>guardrails graph</c>). Returns the path to the site index.\n100\t    /// A task with no attempts on disk is listed (as plain text, not a link) in the index but writes no page.\n101\t    /// This is the post-hoc <c>logs --export</c> surface (SSOT §12.3) — preserved verbatim.\n102\t    /// </summary>\n103\t    public static string ExportSite(string logsRoot, IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks, JournalDocument journal)\n104\t    {\n105\t        Directory.CreateDirectory(logsRoot);\n106\t\n107\t        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n108\t        {\n109\t            WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(logsRoot, task);\n110\t        }\n111\t\n112\t        // Durable export: a settled-with-attempts task links to its static page, a not-yet-run task is\n113\t        // plain text. No live URLs, no meta-refresh (#103 / SSOT §12.3).\n114\t        string index = IndexHtml(\n115\t            journal.RunId,\n116\t            tasks,\n117\t            statusResolver: id => StatusWord(journal, id),\n118\t            linkResolver: id => AttemptDirs(logsRoot, id).Count > 0 ? IndexLink.Static : IndexLink.Plain,\n119\t            includeRefresh: false);\n120\t\n121\t        string indexPath = Path.Combine(logsRoot, \"index.html\");\n122\t        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(indexPath, index);\n123\t        return indexPath;\n124\t    }\n125\t\n126\t    /// <summary>\n127\t    /// Render and atomically write the during-run / final site index to\n128\t    /// <c>&lt;logsRoot&gt;/index.html</c> (issue #141 item 2). The caller supplies the status word and\n129\t    /// the per-task link target so the SAME renderer serves the during-run index (live URLs + refresh)\n130\t    /// and the settled final index (all static, no refresh). <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> is true\n131\t    /// while the run is in flight (so a <c>file://</c> browser re-reads it as it is rewritten) and false\n132\t    /// for the durable final write. Atomic temp+rename so a browser never reads a half-written file.\n133\t    /// Returns the path written.\n134\t    /// </summary>\n135\t    public static string WriteIndex(\n136\t        string logsRoot,\n137\t        string runId,\n138\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n139\t        Func<string, string> statusResolver,\n140\t        Func<string, IndexLink> linkResolver,\n141\t        bool includeRefresh)\n142\t    {\n143\t        string index = IndexHtml(runId, tasks, statusResolver, linkResolver, includeRefresh);\n144\t        string indexPath = Path.Combine(logsRoot, \"index.html\");\n145\t        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(indexPath, index);\n146\t        return indexPath;\n147\t    }\n148\t\n149\t    /// <summary>\n150\t    /// Atomically write one task's static page (<c>&lt;logsRoot&gt;/&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>) with its\n151\t    /// final inlined logs and a Source section, when the task has attempts on disk (issue #141 item 2).\n152\t    /// No-op when the task has no attempts yet. <paramref name=\"logsRoot\"/> is the run's\n153\t    /// <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree. Atomic temp+rename so a browser viewing the page never reads a torn file.\n154\t    /// </summary>\n155\t    public static void WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n156\t    {\n157\t        if (AttemptDirs(logsRoot, task.Id).Count == 0)\n158\t        {\n159\t            return; // nothing to render — task never ran / not started; it stays a non-link in the index\n160\t        }\n161\t\n162\t        string page = TaskPage(logsRoot, task);\n163\t        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id, \"index.html\"), page);\n164\t    }\n165\t\n166\t    // --- site index (projection of status + link target) ------------------------------------\n167\t\n168\t    /// <summary>\n169\t    /// The site landing page: every task with its status word and a link target chosen by the caller's\n170\t    /// <paramref name=\"linkResolver\"/> (static page / live URL / plain text). Regenerated on every write\n171\t    /// (never appended). When <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> is true a <c>meta refresh</c> makes a\n172\t    /// <c>file://</c> view re-read the file as the harness rewrites it (\"updated on the fly\"); the durable\n173\t    /// final / <c>--export</c> index omits it.\n174\t    /// </summary>\n175\t    private static string IndexHtml(\n176\t        string runId,\n177\t        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n178\t        Func<string, string> statusResolver,\n179\t        Func<string, IndexLink> linkResolver,\n180\t        bool includeRefresh)\n181\t    {\n182\t        var rows = new StringBuilder();\n183\t        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n184\t        {\n185\t            string status = statusResolver(task.Id);\n186\t            string cell = IndexCell(task.Id, linkResolver(task.Id));\n187\t\n188\t            rows.Append(\"<tr><td>\").Append(cell).Append(\"</td>\")\n189\t                .Append(\"<td class=\\\"status\\\" data-status=\\\"\").Append(Enc(status)).Append(\"\\\">\")\n190\t                .Append(Enc(status)).Append(\"</td>\")\n191\t                .Append(\"<td>\").Append(Enc(task.Description)).Append(\"</td></tr>\");\n192\t        }\n193\t\n194\t        // The meta-refresh is the \"no server needed\" mechanism for the during-run file:// view (#141):\n195\t        // the browser re-reads index.html every 2s, so a click after a task settles finds the static page.\n196\t        string refresh = includeRefresh\n197\t            ? \"\\n<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\" content=\\\"2\\\">\"\n198\t            : string.Empty;\n199\t\n200\t        string note = includeRefresh\n201\t            ? \"Live run — this page refreshes itself. Running tasks tail their log; settled tasks link to a static page; not-yet-run tasks are plain text.\"\n202\t            : \"Static export of this run. Settled tasks link to their inlined log page; not-yet-run tasks are plain text.\";\n203\t\n204\t        return $\"\"\"\n205\t<!doctype html>\n206\t<html lang=\"en\">\n207\t<head>\n208\t<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n209\t<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">{refresh}\n210\t<title>Guardrails run {Enc(runId)} — log site</title>\n211\t<style>\n212\t{SharedStyle}\n213\t</style>\n214\t</head>\n215\t<body>\n216\t<h1>Guardrails run — task logs</h1>\n217\t<p>{Enc(note)}</p>\n218\t<table>\n219\t<thead><tr><th>Task</th><th>Status</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead>\n220\t<tbody>\n221\t{rows}\n222\t</tbody>\n223\t</table>\n224\t</body>\n225\t</html>\n226\t\"\"\";\n227\t    }\n228\t\n229\t    private static string IndexCell(string taskId, IndexLink link) => link.Kind switch\n230\t    {\n231\t        LinkKind.StaticPage => $\"<a href=\\\"{Uri.EscapeDataString(taskId)}/index.html\\\">{Enc(taskId)}</a>\",\n232\t        LinkKind.Live when link.LiveUrl is { } url => $\"<a href=\\\"{Enc(url)}\\\">{Enc(taskId)}</a>\",\n233\t        _ => Enc(taskId), // PlainText, or a Live link with no URL (no server) → not a link\n234\t    };\n235\t\n236\t    // --- per-task page (inlined attempts + source) ------------------------------------------\n237\t\n238\t    /// <summary>\n239\t    /// One task's static page: every attempt on disk is rendered into its own <c>&lt;section\n240\t    /// data-attempt=\"N\"&gt;</c> (issue #206), each carrying a file <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> combobox that\n241\t    /// toggles between that attempt's files, all inlined as hidden <c>&lt;pre class=\"filebody\"&gt;</c>\n242\t    /// blocks (the PREFERRED file — transcript, else raw stream, else action stdout — shown first).\n243\t    /// Whenever there is at least one attempt, an attempt <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c> — always\n244\t    /// rendered, matching the live viewer's attempt dropdown (<see cref=\"LogServer\"/>: its\n245\t    /// <c>&lt;select id=\"attempt\"&gt;</c> is unconditionally present in the page shell, even with a single\n246\t    /// attempt — populated with just one option) — lets the user pick which attempt's section is visible;\n247\t    /// every attempt's markup stays inlined in the one exported file (a <c>file://</c> page can't fetch\n248\t    /// siblings), the dropdown only shows/hides <c>&lt;section&gt;</c>s. Default selection is the LATEST\n249\t    /// attempt, matching the live viewer's default. (Before issue #241's follow-up, a single-attempt task\n250\t    /// rendered no dropdown at all — an inconsistency with the live viewer, caught live during a real\n251\t    /// dogfood: a user who watched a task pass on attempt 1 in the live view, then checked the exported\n252\t    /// static page afterward, found the dropdown had disappeared.) The existing per-attempt file combobox\n253\t    /// is untouched: it stays nested inside its attempt's <c>&lt;section&gt;</c> and is shown/hidden as\n254\t    /// part of it. A Source section (action file + guardrail scripts from <c>&lt;task.Directory&gt;</c>,\n255\t    /// #141 item 3) and the \"← all tasks\" back-link follow, unchanged.\n256\t    ///\n257\t    /// <para>Trade-off (#145 Feature 2, extended by #206): inlining every attempt's every file bloats the\n258\t    /// page by the full size of each raw stream. Accepted for the audit/demo use — a <c>file://</c> page\n259\t    /// has no other way to show siblings — so it is deliberately uncapped.</para>\n260\t    /// </summary>\n261\t    private static string TaskPage(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n262\t    {\n263\t        IReadOnlyList<int> attempts = AttemptNumbers(logsRoot, task.Id);\n264\t        var sections = new StringBuilder();\n265\t\n266\t        // The latest attempt (highest number) is the default-visible one, matching the live viewer's\n267\t        // \"follow latest\" default (LogServer's TaskTemplate: `asel.value = ... d.attempt`).\n268\t        int latest = attempts.Count > 0 ? attempts[^1] : 0;\n269\t\n270\t        if (attempts.Count > 0)\n271\t        {\n272\t            AppendAttemptSelect(sections, attempts, latest);\n273\t        }\n274\t\n275\t        foreach (int n in attempts)\n276\t        {\n277\t            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id, $\"attempt-{n}\");\n278\t            IReadOnlyList<string> files = AttemptFiles(attemptDir);\n279\t            string? preferred = PreferenceOrder.FirstOrDefault(files.Contains) ?? files.FirstOrDefault();\n280\t            bool visible = n == latest;\n281\t\n282\t            sections.Append(\"<section class=\\\"attempt\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(n).Append('\"')\n283\t                .Append(visible ? string.Empty : \" hidden\").Append('>');\n284\t            sections.Append(\"<h2>attempt \").Append(n).Append(\"</h2>\");\n285\t            AppendAttemptFiles(sections, attemptDir, n, files, preferred);\n286\t            sections.Append(\"</section>\");\n287\t        }\n288\t\n289\t        if (attempts.Count == 0)\n290\t        {\n291\t            sections.Append(\"<pre>no attempts captured</pre>\");\n292\t        }\n293\t\n294\t        sections.Append(SourceSection(logsRoot, task));\n295\t\n296\t        return $\"\"\"\n297\t<!doctype html>\n298\t<html lang=\"en\">\n299\t<head>\n300\t<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n301\t<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n302\t<title>{Enc(task.Id)} — Guardrails log</title>\n303\t<style>\n304\t{SharedStyle}\n305\t</style>\n306\t</head>\n307\t<body>\n308\t<h1>{Enc(task.Id)}</h1>\n309\t<div class=\"bar\"><a href=\"../index.html\">&larr; all tasks</a> &middot; {Enc(task.Description)}</div>\n310\t{sections}\n311\t{FileToggleScript}\n312\t</body>\n313\t</html>\n314\t\"\"\";\n315\t    }\n316\t\n317\t    /// <summary>\n318\t    /// Render the attempt-level <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c> (issue #206): one option per\n319\t    /// attempt (oldest first, matching the on-page section order), the <paramref name=\"latest\"/> attempt\n320\t    /// pre-selected — mirroring the live viewer's \"default to latest\" behaviour. Emitted whenever a task\n321\t    /// has at least one attempt (issue #241) — including exactly one — so the static export always\n322\t    /// matches the live viewer's page shell, which unconditionally carries an attempt <c>&lt;select&gt;</c>\n323\t    /// regardless of how many attempts exist.\n324\t    /// </summary>\n325\t    private static void AppendAttemptSelect(StringBuilder sections, IReadOnlyList<int> attempts, int latest)\n326\t    {\n327\t        sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">attempt <select id=\\\"attemptselect\\\" class=\\\"attemptselect\\\">\");\n328\t        foreach (int n in attempts)\n329\t        {\n330\t            string sel = n == latest ? \" selected\" : string.Empty;\n331\t            sections.Append(\"<option value=\\\"\").Append(n).Append('\"').Append(sel).Append('>')\n332\t                .Append(\"attempt \").Append(n).Append(\"</option>\");\n333\t        }\n334\t\n335\t        sections.Append(\"</select></div>\");\n336\t    }\n337\t\n338\t    /// <summary>\n339\t    /// Render one attempt's file combobox: a <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> listing every file in the attempt (the\n340\t    /// <paramref name=\"preferred\"/> one pre-selected; zero-byte files <c>empty</c>-marked + \" (empty)\"),\n341\t    /// then every file's content inlined as a hidden <c>&lt;pre class=\"filebody\"&gt;</c> (only the preferred\n342\t    /// one shown). All elements carry <c>data-attempt=\"N\"</c> + <c>data-file=\"...\"</c> so the toggle script\n343\t    /// scopes show/hide to THIS attempt — multiple attempts on the page never collide. Content is\n344\t    /// HTML-encoded (arbitrary logs / LLM output) via <see cref=\"Enc\"/> and read through the shared-handle\n345\t    /// <see cref=\"ReadOrEmpty\"/>. An attempt with no files shows a single \"no output captured\" body.\n346\t    /// </summary>\n347\t    private static void AppendAttemptFiles(\n348\t        StringBuilder sections, string attemptDir, int attempt, IReadOnlyList<string> files, string? preferred)\n349\t    {\n350\t        if (files.Count == 0)\n351\t        {\n352\t            sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">showing <code>(no files)</code></div>\");\n353\t            sections.Append(\"<pre class=\\\"filebody\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt)\n354\t                .Append(\"\\\" data-file=\\\"\\\">\").Append(Enc(\"no output captured\")).Append(\"</pre>\");\n355\t            return;\n356\t        }\n357\t\n358\t        // The file <select>: one option per file, scoped to this attempt; the preferred file is selected.\n359\t        sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">file <select class=\\\"fileselect\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append(\"\\\">\");\n360\t        foreach (string f in files)\n361\t        {\n362\t            bool empty = IsZeroByte(Path.Combine(attemptDir, f));\n363\t            string label = empty ? $\"{f} (empty)\" : f;\n364\t            string sel = string.Equals(f, preferred, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? \" selected\" : string.Empty;\n365\t            string cls = empty ? \" class=\\\"empty\\\"\" : string.Empty;\n366\t            sections.Append(\"<option\").Append(cls)\n367\t                .Append(\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append('\"')\n368\t                .Append(\" data-file=\\\"\").Append(Enc(f)).Append('\"').Append(sel).Append('>')\n369\t                .Append(Enc(label)).Append(\"</option>\");\n370\t        }\n371\t\n372\t        sections.Append(\"</select></div>\");\n373\t\n374\t        // Inline every file's content as a hidden <pre>; only the preferred file's block is shown. A\n375\t        // file:// page can't fetch siblings, so all bodies are baked in and the <select> toggles them\n376\t        // (no fetch). Encode every body — arbitrary logs / LLM output. (Trade-off: this bloats the page\n377\t        // by the full raw-stream size; accepted for audit/demo — see TaskPage's remarks. Uncapped.)\n378\t        foreach (string f in files)\n379\t        {\n380\t            string raw = ReadOrEmpty(Path.Combine(attemptDir, f));\n381\t            bool shown = string.Equals(f, preferred, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n382\t            string hidden = shown ? string.Empty : \" hidden\";\n383\t            sections.Append(\"<pre class=\\\"filebody\\\"\").Append(hidden)\n384\t                .Append(\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append('\"')\n385\t                .Append(\" data-file=\\\"\").Append(Enc(f)).Append(\"\\\">\")\n386\t                .Append(Enc(raw.Length > 0 ? raw : \"no output captured\")).Append(\"</pre>\");\n387\t        }\n388\t    }\n389\t\n390\t    /// <summary>\n391\t    /// The vanilla-JS toggle that wires every per-attempt file <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> AND (#206) the\n392\t    /// attempt-level <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c>, reusing the SAME show/hide mechanism for\n393\t    /// both — no second pattern invented: on change, hide every element for that scope and unhide the one\n394\t    /// whose data attribute matches the selected option. The file toggle hides <c>.filebody</c> elements\n395\t    /// scoped by <c>data-attempt</c> so attempts don't collide; the attempt toggle hides\n396\t    /// <c>section.attempt</c> elements scoped by <c>data-attempt</c> (the nested file combobox travels\n397\t    /// with its parent section — switching attempts shows/hides it along with everything else in the\n398\t    /// section, untouched). Pure DOM — NO fetch — because this is a static <c>file://</c> page (a fetch of\n399\t    /// a sibling file is blocked offline).\n400\t    /// </summary>\n401\t    private const string FileToggleScript = \"\"\"\n402\t<script>\n403\t(function () {\n404\t  document.querySelectorAll('select.fileselect').forEach(function (sel) {\n405\t    sel.addEventListener('change', function () {\n406\t      var attempt = sel.getAttribute('data-attempt');\n407\t      var file = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].getAttribute('data-file');\n408\t      document.querySelectorAll('pre.filebody[data-attempt=\"' + attempt + '\"]').forEach(function (pre) {\n409\t        pre.hidden = pre.getAttribute('data-file') !== file;\n410\t      });\n411\t    });\n412\t  });\n413\t\n414\t  var attemptSel = document.getElementById('attemptselect');\n415\t  if (attemptSel) {\n416\t    attemptSel.addEventListener('change', function () {\n417\t      var attempt = attemptSel.options[attemptSel.selectedIndex].value;\n418\t      document.querySelectorAll('section.attempt').forEach(function (section) {\n419\t        section.hidden = section.getAttribute('data-attempt') !== attempt;\n420\t      });\n421\t    });\n422\t  }\n423\t})();\n424\t</script>\n425\t\"\"\";\n426\t\n427\t    /// <summary>\n428\t    /// The static \"Source\" section (#141 item 3): a list of relative <c>file://</c> links from the task's\n429\t    /// static page (<c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>) back to the action file and every\n430\t    /// guardrail script under <c>&lt;task.Directory&gt;</c>, so a user whose guardrail threw can open the\n431\t    /// script with one click. Paths are computed with <see cref=\"Path.GetRelativePath\"/> (browsers open\n432\t    /// text inline). The guardrail scripts are the motivating case, so they get their own sub-list.\n433\t    /// </summary>\n434\t    private static string SourceSection(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n435\t    {\n436\t        // Relative from the page that links them: logs/<runId>/<taskId>/index.html lives in this dir.\n437\t        string fromDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id);\n438\t\n439\t        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n440\t        sb.Append(\"<h2>Source</h2>\");\n441\t\n442\t        SourceFile action = ActionSource(task);\n443\t        sb.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">action: \").Append(SourceLink(fromDir, action)).Append(\"</div>\");\n444\t\n445\t        IReadOnlyList<SourceFile> guardrails = GuardrailSources(task);\n446\t        if (guardrails.Count > 0)\n447\t        {\n448\t            sb.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">guardrails: \");\n449\t            sb.Append(string.Join(\" · \", guardrails.Select(g => SourceLink(fromDir, g))));\n450\t            sb.Append(\"</div>\");\n451\t        }\n452\t\n453\t        return sb.ToString();\n454\t    }\n455\t\n456\t    private static string SourceLink(string fromDir, SourceFile file)\n457\t    {\n458\t        string rel = Path.GetRelativePath(fromDir, file.Path).Replace('\\\\', '/');\n459\t        bool empty = IsZeroByte(file.Path);\n460\t        string label = empty ? $\"{Enc(file.Label)} (empty)\" : Enc(file.Label);\n461\t        string cls = empty ? \" class=\\\"empty\\\"\" : string.Empty;\n462\t        // Encode each path segment so spaces / unusual chars survive as a file:// URL, but keep the\n463\t        // slashes literal so the relative path stays navigable.\n464\t        string href = string.Join('/', rel.Split('/').Select(Uri.EscapeDataString));\n465\t        return $\"<a{cls} href=\\\"{href}\\\">{label}</a>\";\n466\t    }\n467\t\n468\t    // --- source discovery (shared with the live LogServer) ----------------------------------\n469\t\n470\t    /// <summary>A source file the viewers surface: its absolute path plus the label shown to the user.</summary>\n471\t    public readonly record struct SourceFile(string Name, string Label, string Path);\n472\t\n473\t    /// <summary>The task's action file (absolute path + label), from <see cref=\"ActionDefinition.Path\"/>.</summary>\n474\t    public static SourceFile ActionSource(TaskNode task)\n475\t    {\n476\t        string name = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(task.Action.Path);\n477\t        return new SourceFile(name, name, task.Action.Path);\n478\t    }\n479\t\n480\t    /// <summary>\n481\t    /// The task's guardrail source files (absolute path + label), in filename sort order. Each guardrail's\n482\t    /// script is included; an optional <c>&lt;name&gt;.json</c> metadata sidecar (SSOT §4.1) is included\n483\t    /// too when present, so the user sees the full guardrail definition. Ordinal-sorted by label.\n484\t    /// </summary>\n485\t    public static IReadOnlyList<SourceFile> GuardrailSources(TaskNode task)\n486\t    {\n487\t        var files = new List<SourceFile>();\n488\t        foreach (GuardrailDefinition guardrail in task.Guardrails)\n489\t        {\n490\t            string scriptName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(guardrail.Path);\n491\t            files.Add(new SourceFile(scriptName, scriptName, guardrail.Path));\n492\t\n493\t            // The optional metadata sidecar (SSOT §4.1) lives beside the script as <name>.json.\n494\t            string sidecar = System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(guardrail.Path, \".json\");\n495\t            if (File.Exists(sidecar))\n496\t            {\n497\t                string sidecarName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(sidecar);\n498\t                files.Add(new SourceFile(sidecarName, sidecarName, sidecar));\n499\t            }\n500\t        }\n501\t\n502\t        return files.OrderBy(f => f.Label, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n503\t    }\n504\t\n505\t    // --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n506\t\n507\t    private static string StatusWord(JournalDocument journal, string taskId) =>\n508\t        journal.Tasks.TryGetValue(taskId, out TaskJournalEntry? entry) ? StatusText(entry.Status) : \"unknown\";\n509\t\n510\t    /// <summary>Map a journal status to the SSOT status word shown in the UI (shared with the live viewer).</summary>\n511\t    public static string StatusText(JournalTaskStatus status) => status switch\n512\t    {\n513\t        JournalTaskStatus.Pending => \"pending\",\n514\t        JournalTaskStatus.Running => \"running\",\n515\t        JournalTaskStatus.Succeeded => \"succeeded\",\n516\t        JournalTaskStatus.NeedsHuman => \"needs-human\",\n517\t        JournalTaskStatus.Blocked => \"blocked\",\n518\t        JournalTaskStatus.Failed => \"failed\",\n519\t        _ => status.ToString()\n520\t    };\n521\t\n522\t    private static IReadOnlyList<string> AttemptDirs(string logsRoot, string taskId)\n523\t    {\n524\t        string taskDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, taskId);\n525\t        if (!Directory.Exists(taskDir))\n526\t        {\n527\t            return Array.Empty<string>();\n528\t        }\n529\t\n530\t        return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(taskDir)\n531\t            .Where(d => Path.GetFileName(d).StartsWith(\"attempt-\", StringComparison.Ordinal))\n532\t            .ToList();\n533\t    }\n534\t\n535\t    private static IReadOnlyList<int> AttemptNumbers(string logsRoot, string taskId)\n536\t    {\n537\t        var numbers = new List<int>();\n538\t        foreach (string dir in AttemptDirs(logsRoot, taskId))\n539\t        {\n540\t            string leaf = Path.GetFileName(dir);\n541\t            if (int.TryParse(leaf.AsSpan(\"attempt-\".Length), out int n))\n542\t            {\n543\t                numbers.Add(n);\n544\t            }\n545\t        }\n546\t\n547\t        numbers.Sort();\n548\t        return numbers;\n549\t    }\n550\t\n551\t    private static IReadOnlyList<string> AttemptFiles(string attemptDir) =>\n552\t        Directory.Exists(attemptDir)\n553\t            ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(attemptDir)\n554\t                .Select(Path.GetFileName)\n555\t                .Where(n => n is not null)\n556\t                .Select(n => n!)\n557\t                .OrderBy(n => n, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n558\t                .ToList()\n559\t            : Array.Empty<string>();\n560\t\n561\t    /// <summary>True when the file exists and is zero bytes (an empty stdout/stderr capture, #141 item 4).</summary>\n562\t    private static bool IsZeroByte(string path)\n563\t    {\n564\t        try\n565\t        {\n566\t            var info = new FileInfo(path);\n567\t            return info.Exists && info.Length == 0;\n568\t        }\n569\t        catch (IOException)\n570\t        {\n571\t            return false; // never let a stat failure abort the render\n572\t        }\n573\t    }\n574\t\n575\t    /// <summary>Read a file with a fully shared handle (a producer may still be writing); empty if absent.</summary>\n576\t    private static string ReadOrEmpty(string path)\n577\t    {\n578\t        if (!File.Exists(path))\n579\t        {\n580\t            return string.Empty;\n581\t        }\n582\t\n583\t        try\n584\t        {\n585\t            using var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);\n586\t            using var reader = new StreamReader(fs, Encoding.UTF8);\n587\t            return reader.ReadToEnd();\n588\t        }\n589\t        catch (IOException)\n590\t        {\n591\t            return string.Empty; // never let an unreadable artifact abort the whole export\n592\t        }\n593\t    }\n594\t\n595\t    private static string Enc(string s) => WebUtility.HtmlEncode(s);\n596\t}\n597\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"090d00ab-3917-4815-a736-0db5026fcd0d","uuid":"47bac4cc-9ebf-4dcc-abe9-6d532b92f495","timestamp":"2026-07-07T12:24:11.182Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\David\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\guardrails-worktrees\\diagram-live-status-and-search-80c8913d\\71e1ab5c\\01-author-tests-diagram-status-overlay-renderer\\attempt-1\\src\\Guardrails.Cli\\Ui\\LogSiteRenderer.cs","content":"using System.Net;\nusing System.Text;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Journal;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\nusing Guardrails.Core.State;\nusing JournalTaskStatus = Guardrails.Core.Journal.TaskStatus;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// The SINGLE renderer for the log viewer's HTML — the LIVE <see cref=\"LogServer\"/> (dynamic pages\n/// polled client-side), the DURING-RUN static site (rewritten on the fly as tasks settle, issue\n/// #141 item 2), and the DURABLE post-hoc export (<c>guardrails logs --export</c>, SSOT §12.3) all\n/// consume it, so there is no forked look-alike (#103 Request 2). They share the page SHELL (CSS +\n/// layout + the same status colours); they differ ONLY in the index's per-task link target and\n/// whether the index auto-refreshes:\n/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n///   <item>DURING-RUN index — a <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"&gt;</c> so a <c>file://</c> view\n///     re-reads it as the harness rewrites it; a RUNNING task links to the LIVE server URL (a click\n///     tails it), a settled/with-attempts task links to its static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>,\n///     a pending/no-attempts task is plain text.</item>\n///   <item>FINAL / <c>--export</c> index — NO refresh, ALL links static (durable, non-flickering).</item>\n/// </list>\n///\n/// <para>The static site is written next to the artifacts it renders, under the <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c>\n/// audit tree (NEVER <c>state/</c>, which is mutable run state): one <c>index.html</c> per task plus a\n/// site <c>index.html</c>. It is non-authored audit (excluded from <c>guardrails.baseline</c>, like\n/// <c>diagram.html</c>) and is cleared with the rest of <c>logs/</c> by <c>--fresh</c>.</para>\n/// </summary>\npublic static class LogSiteRenderer\n{\n    // The shared page CSS (dark theme + the status-word colours). The live LogServer templates and the\n    // static export both embed THIS constant, so a visual change lands in one place — the renderer-drift\n    // trap the project already solved for diagram.md / diagram.html.\n    public const string SharedStyle = \"\"\"\n  body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 1.5rem; background: #0b0f14; color: #d6deeb; }\n  h1 { font-size: 1.2rem; }\n  h2 { font-size: 1rem; color: #8aa0b3; margin-top: 1.6rem; }\n  p { color: #8aa0b3; }\n  a { color: #7fdbff; text-decoration: none; }\n  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n  .bar { color: #8aa0b3; margin-bottom: .8rem; }\n  table { border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 1rem; width: 100%; }\n  td, th { padding: .45rem .8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c2733; text-align: left; }\n  th { color: #8aa0b3; font-weight: 600; }\n  select { background: #121a24; color: #d6deeb; border: 1px solid #243343; border-radius: 4px; padding: .2rem .4rem; }\n  td.status, span.status { font-weight: 600; }\n  .status[data-status=\"succeeded\"], .status[data-status=\"skipped\"] { color: #3fb950; }\n  .status[data-status=\"needs-human\"], .status[data-status=\"failed\"] { color: #f85149; }\n  .status[data-status=\"running\"] { color: #d29922; }\n  .status[data-status=\"pending\"], .status[data-status=\"blocked\"], .status[data-status=\"unknown\"] { color: #8aa0b3; }\n  .empty, option.empty { color: #6b7a8d; }\n  pre { background: #06090d; border: 1px solid #1c2733; border-radius: 6px; padding: 1rem;\n        white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.35;\n        max-height: 70vh; overflow: auto; }\n\"\"\";\n\n    // Per-attempt file the static page inlines FIRST (mirrors LogServer's PreferenceOrder): the groomed\n    // transcript leads, then the raw stream, then script stdout.\n    private static readonly string[] PreferenceOrder =\n        [\"transcript.md\", \"claude-stream.jsonl\", \"action-stdout.log\"];\n\n    private static readonly Encoding Utf8NoBom = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false);\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The per-task link target an index renders for one task. <see cref=\"StaticPage\"/> points at the\n    /// task's static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>; <see cref=\"Live\"/> carries an absolute live-server\n    /// URL whose click tails the task; <see cref=\"PlainText\"/> renders the id as plain text (no anchor).\n    /// </summary>\n    public enum LinkKind\n    {\n        /// <summary>Plain text — no anchor (a pending / no-attempts task offline).</summary>\n        PlainText,\n\n        /// <summary>A relative link to the task's static <c>&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>.</summary>\n        StaticPage,\n\n        /// <summary>An absolute live-server URL (a click tails the running task).</summary>\n        Live,\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>How an index renders one task: the link target kind plus the URL for a <see cref=\"LinkKind.Live\"/> link.</summary>\n    public readonly record struct IndexLink(LinkKind Kind, string? LiveUrl = null)\n    {\n        /// <summary>A plain-text (non-link) cell.</summary>\n        public static readonly IndexLink Plain = new(LinkKind.PlainText);\n\n        /// <summary>A relative link to the task's static page.</summary>\n        public static readonly IndexLink Static = new(LinkKind.StaticPage);\n\n        /// <summary>An absolute live-server link to tail the running task.</summary>\n        public static IndexLink LiveTo(string url) => new(LinkKind.Live, url);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Export the whole DURABLE static site for one run into <paramref name=\"logsRoot\"/>\n    /// (<c>&lt;planDir&gt;/logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c>): a per-task <c>index.html</c> for every task that\n    /// has attempts on disk, plus a site <c>index.html</c> with NO refresh and ALL-static links. Idempotent\n    /// — regenerates everything each call (like <c>guardrails graph</c>). Returns the path to the site index.\n    /// A task with no attempts on disk is listed (as plain text, not a link) in the index but writes no page.\n    /// This is the post-hoc <c>logs --export</c> surface (SSOT §12.3) — preserved verbatim.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static string ExportSite(string logsRoot, IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks, JournalDocument journal)\n    {\n        Directory.CreateDirectory(logsRoot);\n\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(logsRoot, task);\n        }\n\n        // Durable export: a settled-with-attempts task links to its static page, a not-yet-run task is\n        // plain text. No live URLs, no meta-refresh (#103 / SSOT §12.3).\n        string index = IndexHtml(\n            journal.RunId,\n            tasks,\n            statusResolver: id => StatusWord(journal, id),\n            linkResolver: id => AttemptDirs(logsRoot, id).Count > 0 ? IndexLink.Static : IndexLink.Plain,\n            includeRefresh: false);\n\n        string indexPath = Path.Combine(logsRoot, \"index.html\");\n        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(indexPath, index);\n        return indexPath;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Render and atomically write the during-run / final site index to\n    /// <c>&lt;logsRoot&gt;/index.html</c> (issue #141 item 2). The caller supplies the status word and\n    /// the per-task link target so the SAME renderer serves the during-run index (live URLs + refresh)\n    /// and the settled final index (all static, no refresh). <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> is true\n    /// while the run is in flight (so a <c>file://</c> browser re-reads it as it is rewritten) and false\n    /// for the durable final write. Atomic temp+rename so a browser never reads a half-written file.\n    /// Returns the path written.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static string WriteIndex(\n        string logsRoot,\n        string runId,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        Func<string, string> statusResolver,\n        Func<string, IndexLink> linkResolver,\n        bool includeRefresh)\n    {\n        string index = IndexHtml(runId, tasks, statusResolver, linkResolver, includeRefresh);\n        string indexPath = Path.Combine(logsRoot, \"index.html\");\n        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(indexPath, index);\n        return indexPath;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Atomically write one task's static page (<c>&lt;logsRoot&gt;/&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>) with its\n    /// final inlined logs and a Source section, when the task has attempts on disk (issue #141 item 2).\n    /// No-op when the task has no attempts yet. <paramref name=\"logsRoot\"/> is the run's\n    /// <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree. Atomic temp+rename so a browser viewing the page never reads a torn file.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static void WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n    {\n        if (AttemptDirs(logsRoot, task.Id).Count == 0)\n        {\n            return; // nothing to render — task never ran / not started; it stays a non-link in the index\n        }\n\n        string page = TaskPage(logsRoot, task);\n        AtomicFile.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id, \"index.html\"), page);\n    }\n\n    // --- site index (projection of status + link target) ------------------------------------\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The site landing page: every task with its status word and a link target chosen by the caller's\n    /// <paramref name=\"linkResolver\"/> (static page / live URL / plain text). Regenerated on every write\n    /// (never appended). When <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> is true a <c>meta refresh</c> makes a\n    /// <c>file://</c> view re-read the file as the harness rewrites it (\"updated on the fly\"); the durable\n    /// final / <c>--export</c> index omits it.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static string IndexHtml(\n        string runId,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        Func<string, string> statusResolver,\n        Func<string, IndexLink> linkResolver,\n        bool includeRefresh)\n    {\n        var rows = new StringBuilder();\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            string status = statusResolver(task.Id);\n            string cell = IndexCell(task.Id, linkResolver(task.Id));\n\n            rows.Append(\"<tr><td>\").Append(cell).Append(\"</td>\")\n                .Append(\"<td class=\\\"status\\\" data-status=\\\"\").Append(Enc(status)).Append(\"\\\">\")\n                .Append(Enc(status)).Append(\"</td>\")\n                .Append(\"<td>\").Append(Enc(task.Description)).Append(\"</td></tr>\");\n        }\n\n        // The meta-refresh is the \"no server needed\" mechanism for the during-run file:// view (#141):\n        // the browser re-reads index.html every 2s, so a click after a task settles finds the static page.\n        string refresh = includeRefresh\n            ? \"\\n<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\" content=\\\"2\\\">\"\n            : string.Empty;\n\n        string note = includeRefresh\n            ? \"Live run — this page refreshes itself. Running tasks tail their log; settled tasks link to a static page; not-yet-run tasks are plain text.\"\n            : \"Static export of this run. Settled tasks link to their inlined log page; not-yet-run tasks are plain text.\";\n\n        return $\"\"\"\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">{refresh}\n<title>Guardrails run {Enc(runId)} — log site</title>\n<style>\n{SharedStyle}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<h1>Guardrails run — task logs</h1>\n<p>{Enc(note)}</p>\n<table>\n<thead><tr><th>Task</th><th>Status</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n{rows}\n</tbody>\n</table>\n</body>\n</html>\n\"\"\";\n    }\n\n    private static string IndexCell(string taskId, IndexLink link) => link.Kind switch\n    {\n        LinkKind.StaticPage => $\"<a href=\\\"{Uri.EscapeDataString(taskId)}/index.html\\\">{Enc(taskId)}</a>\",\n        LinkKind.Live when link.LiveUrl is { } url => $\"<a href=\\\"{Enc(url)}\\\">{Enc(taskId)}</a>\",\n        _ => Enc(taskId), // PlainText, or a Live link with no URL (no server) → not a link\n    };\n\n    // --- per-task page (inlined attempts + source) ------------------------------------------\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// One task's static page: every attempt on disk is rendered into its own <c>&lt;section\n    /// data-attempt=\"N\"&gt;</c> (issue #206), each carrying a file <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> combobox that\n    /// toggles between that attempt's files, all inlined as hidden <c>&lt;pre class=\"filebody\"&gt;</c>\n    /// blocks (the PREFERRED file — transcript, else raw stream, else action stdout — shown first).\n    /// Whenever there is at least one attempt, an attempt <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c> — always\n    /// rendered, matching the live viewer's attempt dropdown (<see cref=\"LogServer\"/>: its\n    /// <c>&lt;select id=\"attempt\"&gt;</c> is unconditionally present in the page shell, even with a single\n    /// attempt — populated with just one option) — lets the user pick which attempt's section is visible;\n    /// every attempt's markup stays inlined in the one exported file (a <c>file://</c> page can't fetch\n    /// siblings), the dropdown only shows/hides <c>&lt;section&gt;</c>s. Default selection is the LATEST\n    /// attempt, matching the live viewer's default. (Before issue #241's follow-up, a single-attempt task\n    /// rendered no dropdown at all — an inconsistency with the live viewer, caught live during a real\n    /// dogfood: a user who watched a task pass on attempt 1 in the live view, then checked the exported\n    /// static page afterward, found the dropdown had disappeared.) The existing per-attempt file combobox\n    /// is untouched: it stays nested inside its attempt's <c>&lt;section&gt;</c> and is shown/hidden as\n    /// part of it. A Source section (action file + guardrail scripts from <c>&lt;task.Directory&gt;</c>,\n    /// #141 item 3) and the \"← all tasks\" back-link follow, unchanged.\n    ///\n    /// <para>Trade-off (#145 Feature 2, extended by #206): inlining every attempt's every file bloats the\n    /// page by the full size of each raw stream. Accepted for the audit/demo use — a <c>file://</c> page\n    /// has no other way to show siblings — so it is deliberately uncapped.</para>\n    /// </summary>\n    private static string TaskPage(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n    {\n        IReadOnlyList<int> attempts = AttemptNumbers(logsRoot, task.Id);\n        var sections = new StringBuilder();\n\n        // The latest attempt (highest number) is the default-visible one, matching the live viewer's\n        // \"follow latest\" default (LogServer's TaskTemplate: `asel.value = ... d.attempt`).\n        int latest = attempts.Count > 0 ? attempts[^1] : 0;\n\n        if (attempts.Count > 0)\n        {\n            AppendAttemptSelect(sections, attempts, latest);\n        }\n\n        foreach (int n in attempts)\n        {\n            string attemptDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id, $\"attempt-{n}\");\n            IReadOnlyList<string> files = AttemptFiles(attemptDir);\n            string? preferred = PreferenceOrder.FirstOrDefault(files.Contains) ?? files.FirstOrDefault();\n            bool visible = n == latest;\n\n            sections.Append(\"<section class=\\\"attempt\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(n).Append('\"')\n                .Append(visible ? string.Empty : \" hidden\").Append('>');\n            sections.Append(\"<h2>attempt \").Append(n).Append(\"</h2>\");\n            AppendAttemptFiles(sections, attemptDir, n, files, preferred);\n            sections.Append(\"</section>\");\n        }\n\n        if (attempts.Count == 0)\n        {\n            sections.Append(\"<pre>no attempts captured</pre>\");\n        }\n\n        sections.Append(SourceSection(logsRoot, task));\n\n        return $\"\"\"\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n<meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n<title>{Enc(task.Id)} — Guardrails log</title>\n<style>\n{SharedStyle}\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n<h1>{Enc(task.Id)}</h1>\n<div class=\"bar\"><a href=\"../index.html\">&larr; all tasks</a> &middot; {Enc(task.Description)}</div>\n{sections}\n{FileToggleScript}\n</body>\n</html>\n\"\"\";\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Render the attempt-level <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c> (issue #206): one option per\n    /// attempt (oldest first, matching the on-page section order), the <paramref name=\"latest\"/> attempt\n    /// pre-selected — mirroring the live viewer's \"default to latest\" behaviour. Emitted whenever a task\n    /// has at least one attempt (issue #241) — including exactly one — so the static export always\n    /// matches the live viewer's page shell, which unconditionally carries an attempt <c>&lt;select&gt;</c>\n    /// regardless of how many attempts exist.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendAttemptSelect(StringBuilder sections, IReadOnlyList<int> attempts, int latest)\n    {\n        sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">attempt <select id=\\\"attemptselect\\\" class=\\\"attemptselect\\\">\");\n        foreach (int n in attempts)\n        {\n            string sel = n == latest ? \" selected\" : string.Empty;\n            sections.Append(\"<option value=\\\"\").Append(n).Append('\"').Append(sel).Append('>')\n                .Append(\"attempt \").Append(n).Append(\"</option>\");\n        }\n\n        sections.Append(\"</select></div>\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Render one attempt's file combobox: a <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> listing every file in the attempt (the\n    /// <paramref name=\"preferred\"/> one pre-selected; zero-byte files <c>empty</c>-marked + \" (empty)\"),\n    /// then every file's content inlined as a hidden <c>&lt;pre class=\"filebody\"&gt;</c> (only the preferred\n    /// one shown). All elements carry <c>data-attempt=\"N\"</c> + <c>data-file=\"...\"</c> so the toggle script\n    /// scopes show/hide to THIS attempt — multiple attempts on the page never collide. Content is\n    /// HTML-encoded (arbitrary logs / LLM output) via <see cref=\"Enc\"/> and read through the shared-handle\n    /// <see cref=\"ReadOrEmpty\"/>. An attempt with no files shows a single \"no output captured\" body.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendAttemptFiles(\n        StringBuilder sections, string attemptDir, int attempt, IReadOnlyList<string> files, string? preferred)\n    {\n        if (files.Count == 0)\n        {\n            sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">showing <code>(no files)</code></div>\");\n            sections.Append(\"<pre class=\\\"filebody\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt)\n                .Append(\"\\\" data-file=\\\"\\\">\").Append(Enc(\"no output captured\")).Append(\"</pre>\");\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // The file <select>: one option per file, scoped to this attempt; the preferred file is selected.\n        sections.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">file <select class=\\\"fileselect\\\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append(\"\\\">\");\n        foreach (string f in files)\n        {\n            bool empty = IsZeroByte(Path.Combine(attemptDir, f));\n            string label = empty ? $\"{f} (empty)\" : f;\n            string sel = string.Equals(f, preferred, StringComparison.Ordinal) ? \" selected\" : string.Empty;\n            string cls = empty ? \" class=\\\"empty\\\"\" : string.Empty;\n            sections.Append(\"<option\").Append(cls)\n                .Append(\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append('\"')\n                .Append(\" data-file=\\\"\").Append(Enc(f)).Append('\"').Append(sel).Append('>')\n                .Append(Enc(label)).Append(\"</option>\");\n        }\n\n        sections.Append(\"</select></div>\");\n\n        // Inline every file's content as a hidden <pre>; only the preferred file's block is shown. A\n        // file:// page can't fetch siblings, so all bodies are baked in and the <select> toggles them\n        // (no fetch). Encode every body — arbitrary logs / LLM output. (Trade-off: this bloats the page\n        // by the full raw-stream size; accepted for audit/demo — see TaskPage's remarks. Uncapped.)\n        foreach (string f in files)\n        {\n            string raw = ReadOrEmpty(Path.Combine(attemptDir, f));\n            bool shown = string.Equals(f, preferred, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n            string hidden = shown ? string.Empty : \" hidden\";\n            sections.Append(\"<pre class=\\\"filebody\\\"\").Append(hidden)\n                .Append(\" data-attempt=\\\"\").Append(attempt).Append('\"')\n                .Append(\" data-file=\\\"\").Append(Enc(f)).Append(\"\\\">\")\n                .Append(Enc(raw.Length > 0 ? raw : \"no output captured\")).Append(\"</pre>\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The vanilla-JS toggle that wires every per-attempt file <c>&lt;select&gt;</c> AND (#206) the\n    /// attempt-level <c>&lt;select id=\"attemptselect\"&gt;</c>, reusing the SAME show/hide mechanism for\n    /// both — no second pattern invented: on change, hide every element for that scope and unhide the one\n    /// whose data attribute matches the selected option. The file toggle hides <c>.filebody</c> elements\n    /// scoped by <c>data-attempt</c> so attempts don't collide; the attempt toggle hides\n    /// <c>section.attempt</c> elements scoped by <c>data-attempt</c> (the nested file combobox travels\n    /// with its parent section — switching attempts shows/hides it along with everything else in the\n    /// section, untouched). Pure DOM — NO fetch — because this is a static <c>file://</c> page (a fetch of\n    /// a sibling file is blocked offline).\n    /// </summary>\n    private const string FileToggleScript = \"\"\"\n<script>\n(function () {\n  document.querySelectorAll('select.fileselect').forEach(function (sel) {\n    sel.addEventListener('change', function () {\n      var attempt = sel.getAttribute('data-attempt');\n      var file = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].getAttribute('data-file');\n      document.querySelectorAll('pre.filebody[data-attempt=\"' + attempt + '\"]').forEach(function (pre) {\n        pre.hidden = pre.getAttribute('data-file') !== file;\n      });\n    });\n  });\n\n  var attemptSel = document.getElementById('attemptselect');\n  if (attemptSel) {\n    attemptSel.addEventListener('change', function () {\n      var attempt = attemptSel.options[attemptSel.selectedIndex].value;\n      document.querySelectorAll('section.attempt').forEach(function (section) {\n        section.hidden = section.getAttribute('data-attempt') !== attempt;\n      });\n    });\n  }\n})();\n</script>\n\"\"\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The static \"Source\" section (#141 item 3): a list of relative <c>file://</c> links from the task's\n    /// static page (<c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/&lt;taskId&gt;/index.html</c>) back to the action file and every\n    /// guardrail script under <c>&lt;task.Directory&gt;</c>, so a user whose guardrail threw can open the\n    /// script with one click. Paths are computed with <see cref=\"Path.GetRelativePath\"/> (browsers open\n    /// text inline). The guardrail scripts are the motivating case, so they get their own sub-list.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static string SourceSection(string logsRoot, TaskNode task)\n    {\n        // Relative from the page that links them: logs/<runId>/<taskId>/index.html lives in this dir.\n        string fromDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, task.Id);\n\n        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n        sb.Append(\"<h2>Source</h2>\");\n\n        SourceFile action = ActionSource(task);\n        sb.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">action: \").Append(SourceLink(fromDir, action)).Append(\"</div>\");\n\n        IReadOnlyList<SourceFile> guardrails = GuardrailSources(task);\n        if (guardrails.Count > 0)\n        {\n            sb.Append(\"<div class=\\\"bar\\\">guardrails: \");\n            sb.Append(string.Join(\" · \", guardrails.Select(g => SourceLink(fromDir, g))));\n            sb.Append(\"</div>\");\n        }\n\n        return sb.ToString();\n    }\n\n    private static string SourceLink(string fromDir, SourceFile file)\n    {\n        string rel = Path.GetRelativePath(fromDir, file.Path).Replace('\\\\', '/');\n        bool empty = IsZeroByte(file.Path);\n        string label = empty ? $\"{Enc(file.Label)} (empty)\" : Enc(file.Label);\n        string cls = empty ? \" class=\\\"empty\\\"\" : string.Empty;\n        // Encode each path segment so spaces / unusual chars survive as a file:// URL, but keep the\n        // slashes literal so the relative path stays navigable.\n        string href = string.Join('/', rel.Split('/').Select(Uri.EscapeDataString));\n        return $\"<a{cls} href=\\\"{href}\\\">{label}</a>\";\n    }\n\n    // --- source discovery (shared with the live LogServer) ----------------------------------\n\n    /// <summary>A source file the viewers surface: its absolute path plus the label shown to the user.</summary>\n    public readonly record struct SourceFile(string Name, string Label, string Path);\n\n    /// <summary>The task's action file (absolute path + label), from <see cref=\"ActionDefinition.Path\"/>.</summary>\n    public static SourceFile ActionSource(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        string name = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(task.Action.Path);\n        return new SourceFile(name, name, task.Action.Path);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The task's guardrail source files (absolute path + label), in filename sort order. Each guardrail's\n    /// script is included; an optional <c>&lt;name&gt;.json</c> metadata sidecar (SSOT §4.1) is included\n    /// too when present, so the user sees the full guardrail definition. Ordinal-sorted by label.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static IReadOnlyList<SourceFile> GuardrailSources(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        var files = new List<SourceFile>();\n        foreach (GuardrailDefinition guardrail in task.Guardrails)\n        {\n            string scriptName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(guardrail.Path);\n            files.Add(new SourceFile(scriptName, scriptName, guardrail.Path));\n\n            // The optional metadata sidecar (SSOT §4.1) lives beside the script as <name>.json.\n            string sidecar = System.IO.Path.ChangeExtension(guardrail.Path, \".json\");\n            if (File.Exists(sidecar))\n            {\n                string sidecarName = System.IO.Path.GetFileName(sidecar);\n                files.Add(new SourceFile(sidecarName, sidecarName, sidecar));\n            }\n        }\n\n        return files.OrderBy(f => f.Label, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n    }\n\n    // --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static string StatusWord(JournalDocument journal, string taskId) =>\n        journal.Tasks.TryGetValue(taskId, out TaskJournalEntry? entry) ? StatusText(entry.Status) : \"unknown\";\n\n    /// <summary>Map a journal status to the SSOT status word shown in the UI (shared with the live viewer).</summary>\n    public static string StatusText(JournalTaskStatus status) => status switch\n    {\n        JournalTaskStatus.Pending => \"pending\",\n        JournalTaskStatus.Running => \"running\",\n        JournalTaskStatus.Succeeded => \"succeeded\",\n        JournalTaskStatus.NeedsHuman => \"needs-human\",\n        JournalTaskStatus.Blocked => \"blocked\",\n        JournalTaskStatus.Failed => \"failed\",\n        _ => status.ToString()\n    };\n\n    private static IReadOnlyList<string> AttemptDirs(string logsRoot, string taskId)\n    {\n        string taskDir = Path.Combine(logsRoot, taskId);\n        if (!Directory.Exists(taskDir))\n        {\n            return Array.Empty<string>();\n        }\n\n        return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(taskDir)\n            .Where(d => Path.GetFileName(d).StartsWith(\"attempt-\", StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            .ToList();\n    }\n\n    private static IReadOnlyList<int> AttemptNumbers(string logsRoot, string taskId)\n    {\n        var numbers = new List<int>();\n        foreach (string dir in AttemptDirs(logsRoot, taskId))\n        {\n            string leaf = Path.GetFileName(dir);\n            if (int.TryParse(leaf.AsSpan(\"attempt-\".Length), out int n))\n            {\n                numbers.Add(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        numbers.Sort();\n        return numbers;\n    }\n\n    private static IReadOnlyList<string> AttemptFiles(string attemptDir) =>\n        Directory.Exists(attemptDir)\n            ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(attemptDir)\n                .Select(Path.GetFileName)\n                .Where(n => n is not null)\n                .Select(n => n!)\n                .OrderBy(n => n, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n                .ToList()\n            : Array.Empty<string>();\n\n    /// <summary>True when the file exists and is zero bytes (an empty stdout/stderr capture, #141 item 4).</summary>\n    private static bool IsZeroByte(string path)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            var info = new FileInfo(path);\n            return info.Exists && info.Length == 0;\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            return false; // never let a stat failure abort the render\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Read a file with a fully shared handle (a producer may still be writing); empty if absent.</summary>\n    private static string ReadOrEmpty(string path)\n    {\n        if (!File.Exists(path))\n        {\n            return string.Empty;\n        }\n\n        try\n        {\n            using var fs = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);\n            using var reader = new StreamReader(fs, Encoding.UTF8);\n            return reader.ReadToEnd();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            return string.Empty; // never let an unreadable artifact abort the whole export\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static string Enc(string s) => WebUtility.HtmlEncode(s);\n}\n","numLines":597,"startLine":1,"totalLines":597}}}

Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n267\t    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n268\t    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n269\t    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n270\t    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n271\t    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n272\t    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n273\t    /// </summary>\n274\t    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)\n275\t    {\n276\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff,stroke:#6f42c1,color:#2e1065;\");\n277\t        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b,color:#3d2c00;\");\n278\t    }\n279\t\n280\t    /// <summary>\n281\t    /// The SEMANTIC content of the diagram: ONLY the containers + nested checks + container edges\n282\t    /// (with their drawn labels), with NO <c>flowchart TD</c> header and NO cosmetic\n283\t    /// <c>classDef</c> color definitions. This is what <see cref=\"GraphSourceHash\"/> hashes, so\n284\t    /// the staleness key tracks exactly what the diagram DRAWS (container membership, nested\n285\t    /// check labels, DAG shape) — including the PLAN-LEVEL <c>preflights/</c>/<c>guardrails/</c>\n286\t    /// folder checks, not just <c>tasks{}</c>, so editing a Terminal Gate check moves the hash\n287\t    /// too. Shares the single <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> emitter with <see cref=\"Render\"/>,\n288\t    /// so the two can never drift.\n289\t    /// </summary>\n290\t    internal static string SemanticContent(PlanDefinition plan)\n291\t    {\n292\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n293\t\n294\t        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n295\t        AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n296\t        return sb.ToString();\n297\t    }\n298\t\n299\t    /// <summary>\n300\t    /// Append the container model (the semantic content) for the plan: the plan-level Full Flight\n301\t    /// Checks container, one container per task in ordinal order, the plan-level Terminal Gate\n302\t    /// container, and finally every container→container edge. The single shared emitter behind\n303\t    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>, <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>, and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> —\n304\t    /// all three now emit the IDENTICAL container/node shape (issue #235 removed the interactive-only\n305\t    /// anchor node), so <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> differ ONLY in\n306\t    /// whether <c>click</c> directives for CHECK nodes are appended afterward. Returns the\n307\t    /// task-id → node-id-base map so the caller can emit click directives against the SAME node ids\n308\t    /// (the emitted bytes are unchanged whether or not the caller uses the return value).\n309\t    /// </summary>\n310\t    /// <remarks>\n311\t    /// ORDER MATTERS: every container is emitted (fully, including its <c>end</c>) BEFORE any\n312\t    /// container→container edge line. A <c>subgraph A --&gt; subgraph B</c> edge references the two\n313\t    /// container ids, so both subgraph blocks must already be declared; emitting all containers\n314\t    /// first keeps every edge's endpoints resolvable and the output deterministic.\n315\t    /// </remarks>\n316\t    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AppendNodesAndEdges(PlanDefinition plan, StringBuilder sb)\n317\t    {\n318\t        var graph = new DependencyGraph(plan.Tasks);\n319\t\n320\t        // Ordinal task order throughout (repo convention).\n321\t        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks\n322\t            .OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n323\t            .ToList();\n324\t\n325\t        // Allocate an injective node-id base per task ONCE, in ordinal order: a task    /// paths (not OS separators, not absolute) for the same byte-identical-across-OSes reason as\n    /// <see cref=\"ToPlanRelative\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n\n        var targets = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            string containerId = $\"task_{nodeIdBase[task.Id]}\";\n            targets[containerId] = ToPlanRelative(plan.PlanDirectory, task.Directory) + \"/\";\n        }\n\n        return targets;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines (colors) for the LEAF check nodes — preflight check\n    /// and guardrail check — which reference them inline via <c>:::preflight</c>/<c>:::guardrail</c>.\n    /// The task-container and plan-level-container fills are applied per-container by a\n    /// <c>style &lt;id&gt; …</c> statement instead (see <see cref=\"TaskStyle\"/> /\n    /// <see cref=\"PlanLevelStyle\"/>), because a <c>class</c> assignment does not reach a subgraph\n    /// that is an edge endpoint in the bundled Mermaid. Shared by <see cref=\"Render\"/> and\n    /// <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/>; deliberately EXCLUDED from the staleness key (see\n    /// <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>), which is why <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/> does not call it.\n    /// No longer emits an <c>invisible</c> classDef (issue #211's anchor-node mechanism was removed\n    /// entirely — issue #235; see class remarks): the task-container click target is now a\n    /// post-render SVG overlay <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer\"/> injects via JavaScript, not a\n    /// Mermaid node/class at all.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void AppendClassDefs(StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef preflight fill:#e6d7ff,stroke:#6f42c1,color:#2e1065;\");\n        AppendLf(sb, \"  classDef guardrail fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#b8860b,color:#3d2c00;\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// The SEMANTIC content of the diagram: ONLY the containers + nested checks + container edges\n    /// (with their drawn labels), with NO <c>flowchart TD</c> header and NO cosmetic\n    /// <c>classDef</c> color definitions. This is what <see cref=\"GraphSourceHash\"/> hashes, so\n    /// the staleness key tracks exactly what the diagram DRAWS (container membership, nested\n    /// check labels, DAG shape) — including the PLAN-LEVEL <c>preflights/</c>/<c>guardrails/</c>\n    /// folder checks, not just <c>tasks{}</c>, so editing a Terminal Gate check moves the hash\n    /// too. Shares the single <see cref=\"AppendNodesAndEdges\"/> emitter with <see cref=\"Render\"/>,\n    /// so the two can never drift.\n    /// </summary>\n    internal static string SemanticContent(PlanDefinition plan)\n    {\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(plan);\n\n        var sb = new StringBuilder();\n        AppendNodesAndEdges(plan, sb);\n        return sb.ToString();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append the container model (the semantic content) for the plan: the plan-level Full Flight\n    /// Checks container, one container per task in ordinal order, the plan-level Terminal Gate\n    /// container, and finally every container→container edge. The single shared emitter behind\n    /// <see cref=\"Render\"/>, <see cref=\"SemanticContent\"/>, and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> —\n    /// all three now emit the IDENTICAL container/node shape (issue #235 removed the interactive-only\n    /// anchor node), so <see cref=\"Render\"/> and <see cref=\"RenderInteractive\"/> differ ONLY in\n    /// whether <c>click</c> directives for CHECK nodes are appended afterward. Returns the\n    /// task-id → node-id-base map so the caller can emit click directives against the SAME node ids\n    /// (the emitted bytes are unchanged whether or not the caller uses the return value).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <remarks>\n    /// ORDER MATTERS: every container is emitted (fully, including its <c>end</c>) BEFORE any\n    /// container→container edge line. A <c>subgraph A --&gt; subgraph B</c> edge references the two\n    /// container ids, so both subgraph blocks must already be declared; emitting all containers\n    /// first keeps every edge's endpoints resolvable and the output deterministic.\n    /// </remarks>\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AppendNodesAndEdges(PlanDefinition plan, StringBuilder sb)\n    {\n        var graph = new DependencyGraph(plan.Tasks);\n\n        // Ordinal task order throughout (repo convention).\n        List<TaskNode> tasks = plan.Tasks\n            .OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal)\n            .ToList();\n\n        // Allocate an injective node-id base per task ONCE, in ordinal order: a task whose\n        // sanitized id collides with an earlier one gets a deterministic _2, _3, … suffix.\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeIdBase = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n\n        // --- plan-level \"Full Flight Checks\" container (top, ALWAYS emitted) -----------\n        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanPreflightsId, \"Full Flight Checks\", plan.PlanPreflights, \"preflight\");\n\n        // --- one container per task ------------------------------------------------------\n        foreach (TaskNode task in tasks)\n        {\n            AppendTaskContainer(sb, task, nodeIdBase[task.Id]);\n        }\n\n        // --- plan-level \"Terminal Gate\" container (bottom, ALWAYS emitted) --------------\n        AppendPlanLevelContainer(sb, PlanGuardrailsId, \"Terminal Gate\", plan.PlanGuardrails, \"guardrail\");\n\n        // --- container→container edges (every container above is already fully declared) -----\n        AppendContainerEdges(graph, tasks, nodeIdBase, sb);\n\n        return nodeIdBase;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Append a plan-level bracket container (<c>plan_preflights</c> or <c>plan_guardrails</c>):\n    /// its checks (sorted ordinal by name) as small boxes inside, styled with","numLines":110,"startLine":240,"totalLines":648}}}
